newsitem.title: GERMANY: German jobless seen up 14,000 in February.
newsitem.headline: German jobless seen up 14,000 in February.

text.p: The number of German jobless rose by 14,000 to 4.672 million in February from the month before, setting another post-war record after months of rising unemployment, labour market sources told Reuters on Wednesday.
Unemployment stood at 4.66 million in January, the highest level since the Great Depression of the 1930s.
Earlier this week, Finance Minister Theo Waigel said unemployment data to be released on Thursday would show that jobless totals had risen only slightly last month.
The sources, who asked not to be identified, said mild weather in February had helped to slow the rise in unemployment.
